speaker: Doctor
text: I see you're experiencing fatigue, abdominal pain, night sweats, weight loss, and an enlarged supraclavicular lymph node. To help narrow down the cause, could you tell me if you've had any recent fevers, changes in your bowel habits, or difficulty swallowing? Also, have you noticed any pain or tenderness in the enlarged lymph node?

speaker: Patient
text: I have been feeling very tired and have had worsening abdominal pain for about four weeks. I have also had drenching night sweats and lost about twelve pounds.

speaker: Doctor
text: Have you noticed any pain or tenderness when I press on that enlarged lymph node, and have you experienced any recent fevers or changes in your bowel habits?

speaker: Patient
text: I noticed swelling in my neck over the last few days. It does not hurt, but it feels enlarged and fixed.

speaker: Doctor
text:
The absence of pain in the lymph node is concerning for malignancy rather than infection. I will order a biopsy of the lymph node and a CT scan of your chest, abdomen, and pelvis to evaluate for underlying pathology.
REQUEST TEST: Lymph Node Biopsy
REQUEST TEST: CT Chest Abdomen Pelvis

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Lymph Node Biopsy: Lymphocytes with a high proliferative index that stain positive for CD20. CT Chest Abdomen Pelvis: Massively enlarged axillary, mediastinal, and cervical lymph nodes.

speaker: Doctor
text: The biopsy results showing CD20-positive lymphocytes with a high proliferative index, combined with the widespread lymphadenopathy, strongly indicate a B-cell non-Hodgkin lymphoma. DIAGNOSIS READY: Non-Hodgkin Lymphoma
